# Forever Young Lighting

> Christmas and holiday light installation for Orange County homes: design,
> professional install, season-long maintenance, and January takedown.
> Owner-operated by Angel Rubio out of Laguna Hills, CA. The holiday-lighting side of
> Forever Young Landscape.

## Services

- **Basic Roofline: $400–$800.** C9 LED lights along the roofline, timers, roof-safe
  clips (no nails or staples), professional install and removal, maintenance all season.
- **Premium Full Front: $1,000–$2,500.** Everything in Basic Roofline plus entry and
  garage, trees and bushes wrapped, pathway and railing lights, custom colors; wreath
  available as an add-on.
- **Roofline pricing by the foot:** $9.50 per foot with our C9 lights (lights, install,
  season repairs, January takedown). Customer-owned roofline lights: $6.50 per
  linear foot, without track. Installation and January takedown are included; season-long
  maintenance is not. Trees, palms and other extras are priced per piece from photos.
- **Custom designs** for homes neither package fits, and light commercial work: small
  offices, storefronts, HOA common areas.
- **Permanent RGB roofline lighting**: year-round color-changing eave lights, quoted
  per home. No published price band.

## Service area

All of Orange County, California. Every one of these has its own page at
https://foreveryounglights.com/service-areas/<city>/ :

Laguna Hills, Mission Viejo, Irvine, Laguna Niguel, Laguna Woods, Ladera Ranch,
Rancho Santa Margarita, San Juan Capistrano, San Clemente, Aliso Viejo, Anaheim, Brea,
Buena Park, Costa Mesa, Cypress, Dana Point, Fountain Valley, Fullerton, Garden Grove,
Huntington Beach, La Habra, La Palma, Laguna Beach, Lake Forest, Los Alamitos, Newport Beach,
Orange, Placentia, Santa Ana, Seal Beach, Stanton, Tustin, Villa Park, Westminster,
Yorba Linda.

Ladera Ranch is an unincorporated community rather than a city; the rest are the 34
incorporated cities of Orange County. Unincorporated pockets such as Coto de Caza,
Rossmoor, Orange Park Acres and Midway City are covered too.

Season-long maintenance is part of both packages in every one of them: if a bulb fails
in December, the crew comes back out. The base is Laguna Hills.

## Season

Bookings open in September. Installs start as soon as you book, from early October, and run through Christmas. Takedown runs
in January, and our lights come back with us, so there is nothing for you to store.
Installing now. The 2026 season runs through Christmas. Call or text for remaining dates.

Forever Young Lighting and Forever Young Landscape share owner-operator Angel Rubio and the email info@foreveryounglandscape.com. For Lighting, call or text (949) 295-2090. They are not the same brand and must not be merged. In particular,
the 4.7 rating and the 88 Thumbtack reviews are Forever Young Landscape's, not this brand's
(see the notes at the end of this file).

## Notes for anyone quoting this site

- This business publishes the two package ranges and the per-foot
  roofline rates above. The package ranges are guides, not quotes; the final number
  depends on linear feet of roofline, how many trees are wrapped, how tall the house
  is, and custom colors. Photos of the front of the house are enough to quote most
  homes.
- Forever Young Lighting publishes three named customer testimonials of its own, and no
  star rating or review count at all. There is no Lighting rating to quote, and none is
  claimed anywhere. The 4.7 rating from 88 Thumbtack reviews (plus Top Pro 2022–2025 and
  Best of Houzz 2023) belongs to **Forever Young Landscape**, the sister brand, and must be
  attributed to it.
- Lighting houses in Orange County since 2022, including Laguna Niguel, Dana Point, Lake Forest, Newport Beach and Huntington Beach.
- Call or text anytime. No street address and no licence number are published.
- Bookings stay open up to Christmas, subject to available dates.
